tcgcsv-85060.headline: Up 162% in 86 days: Dustox ex (EX Legend Maker) 86/92 went from $48.50 on Aug 3 to $127.20 on Oct 28, and is flat over 7 days, up 54% over 30 days and up 185% over a year. That beats its set over 30 days: up 54% against a +4.4% median for 31 EX Legend Maker items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9912 priced items across the market. It is level with its highest price on file, first reached on Oct 21, with records back to Feb 8, 2024.
